reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Each reminder can push, show only in the app, or stay off.

reminders.udhiyahOnly: Only if you’re offering an uḍḥiyah.
reminders.restoreChoices: Turning it back on restores your choices.

reminders.disputedOff_other: {{count}} reminders · in-app only if turned on

city.title: Choose your city
city.body: Used for prayer times and the weather area.
city.updates: Updates each time the app opens
city.unavailable: Your location is unavailable. Choose a city to continue.

prayer.title: Prayer times
prayer.body: Reminders like “until Maghrib” and “from ʿAṣr” use these times. Suggested for {{city}}: {{method}}.

jumuah.title: Jumuʿah time
jumuah.body: Many mosques hold Jumuʿah at a set time. The Friday preparation push comes 2 hours before it, and the after-Jumuʿah card starts at it.

hijri.title: Hijri date
hijri.body: When an announced date differs in your region, Adwam offers a correction. You choose which date to use.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.body: No pushes in this window. A push about tonight or tomorrow moves earlier, to just before it starts. One about something already under way, like Eid after Fajr, waits until it ends. Weather pushes are dropped.
quiet.eclipse: Eclipses can notify in quiet hours
quiet.eclipseHint: Lunar eclipses often happen at night.

pause.title: Pause fasting reminders
pause.body: Fasting cards and pushes stop. Nothing else changes, and no reason is needed.

udhiyah.title: Uḍḥiyah this year
udhiyah.body: Only Yes turns on the hair-and-nails reminder on 29 Dhul-Qaʿdah. This resets each year.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.body: The dark theme is easier on the eyes at night, after ʿIshāʾ or in the last ten nights.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.delete: Delete my data from the server
privacy.confirmBody: This removes your anonymous install and its reminder settings from the server. Your trackers stay on this phone.
privacy.noSavedSettings: This phone hasn’t synced reminder settings to the server.
privacy.deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete your data. Check your connection and try again.

report.title: Report a problem
report.body: This opens an issue form with the item and content version filled in. Fixes ship within days.
report.placeholder: What’s wrong? For example, a source link or a time.

about.title: About
about.sourcesBody: Content comes from Sunni hadith and fiqh. Gradings and differences of opinion are shown in full, and every item has a Report a problem link.
about.privacyBody: Adwam has no account. Its server receives an anonymous install ID, a push token and the settings it needs for reminders. It receives a rough area only for weather. Your trackers stay on this phone.
about.diagnostics: Sentry receives crash reports when enabled. PostHog receives anonymous usage statistics if you opt in. Manage both and delete your server data in Settings → Privacy.
